protected_invariants.heading: Purpose
protected_invariants.text: Maps the method's abstract verbs onto Things 3 and describes the bridge script that enforces the write rules. The method rules live in `engos-operations-gtd-planning`. This file holds only what is specific to Things.

protected_invariants.heading: Primary Objective
protected_invariants.text: Read and write Things 3 for the GTD method only through the bridge, so every write rule is enforced by code, and report each result as observed.

protected_invariants.heading: Tool Boundaries
protected_invariants.text: - macOS only. Things must be running.

protected_invariants.heading: Tool Boundaries
protected_invariants.text: - Checklists, repeat rules and headings cannot be read by scripts. Never say what a checklist holds. If a change might touch one (rename, split), tell the user you cannot see it.

protected_invariants.heading: Tool Boundaries
protected_invariants.text: - Touch Things only through the bridge. Never open the database, use the `things:///` URL scheme, or write your own AppleScript.

protected_invariants.heading: Required Inputs
protected_invariants.text: ## Required Inputs

protected_invariants.heading: Workflow Contract
protected_invariants.text: Touch Things only through the bridge. Run it as shown, read before writing, and show a dry run before any real `move`.

protected_invariants.heading: Environment variables
protected_invariants.text: | `THINGS_INTERACTIVE=1` | Allows `move` and `clear-schedule`. Set only by the interactive entry point. Scheduled or unattended runs never set it. Without it, those commands are refused. |

protected_invariants.heading: Environment variables
protected_invariants.text: | `THINGS_TAG_ALLOWLIST` | Comma-separated tags. In an unattended run, `add` accepts only these. Others are dropped. |

protected_invariants.heading: Commands
protected_invariants.text: | `snapshot` | snapshot | Open items in Inbox, Today, Upcoming, Anytime, Someday, plus areas, projects (with ids) and tags. Today items also appear under Anytime; count each id once. Notes are cut at 400 characters. Required columns id, name, notes, tags must have equal length or the call aborts; optional columns (area, project) are exempt. Observed once: a live snapshot on one real database showed equal column lengths. Not tested: what a failed column read does, so keep the assert. |

protected_invariants.heading: Commands
protected_invariants.text: | `add` | capture | Items `{title, notes, tags, deadline, src}`. Inbox only. Refuses more than 25 at once. Skips a key already present (open items, and completed in the last 30 days). Drops unknown tags. Caps note length. Strips `src:` lines from untrusted text. Reads the key from the last notes line only. |

protected_invariants.heading: Commands
protected_invariants.text: | `capabilities`, `--version` | | Command names and contract version. Read-only. |

protected_invariants.heading: Commands
protected_invariants.text: Use projects by `projectId`, never by name; names repeat.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules the bridge enforces
protected_invariants.text: - `move` adds tags, never removes. Appends to notes without trimming, re-reads before writing, and checks the old notes are a prefix of the new. A new title keeps the old one in notes ("Original title: ..."). A deadline is replaced only with `replaceDeadline: true`, and the old one goes to notes ("Deadline was: ...").

protected_invariants.heading: Rules the bridge enforces
protected_invariants.text: - `add` writes to the Inbox only. Never creates areas, projects or tags.

protected_invariants.heading: Edit format
protected_invariants.text: Follow the item's own pattern. If its notes have a first line, bullets, an `Action:` line or links, leave them and add below in the same style. Do not move an item out of its project or heading unless asked.

protected_invariants.heading: GTD to Things mapping
protected_invariants.text: | Tickler | Start date (Upcoming) | `clear-schedule` removes it. Verified on real Things 2026-11-08 on two items. One in an area with no project: start date cleared, area and notes kept, item left only in Anytime. One inside a project under a heading, with a tag: start date cleared, project and tag kept, and the user confirmed on screen it stayed under its heading. Headings cannot be read by scripts, so this was a visual check |

protected_invariants.heading: Waiting For encoding
protected_invariants.text: Tags: the waiting tag from the profile plus the person's tag. First notes line: `Waiting since: YYYY-MM-DD`. The adapter parses this line to compute age. A person tag is added only when sure it is the same person.

protected_invariants.text: ## Required Output

protected_invariants.heading: Invocation Hints
protected_invariants.text: - Use only when the profile lists `things3` under adapters.

protected_invariants.heading: Examples
protected_invariants.text: | Move an item after a yes (interactive only) | `THINGS_INTERACTIVE=1 osascript -l JavaScript resources/things.js move @move.json` |

protected_invariants.heading: Evaluation Rubric
protected_invariants.text: | Capture | `add` wrote to the Inbox only, at most 25 items, skipped keys already present, dropped unknown tags, capped notes, stripped `src:` lines from untrusted text. |

protected_invariants.heading: Evaluation Rubric
protected_invariants.text: | Existing items | `move` only added tags and appended notes. Old title and deadline were kept in notes. A dry run was shown first. |
